# olivares_model_access (Resource)

A model access rule in the Olivares AI control plane (models module): a subject-scoped allow/deny gate on a model pattern with a priority. Authoring requires models:model-access:admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Model access is evaluated by PRIORITY, lowest first, and the first matching rule wins.
# Keep allow rules at a lower priority than the deny rules that must override them.
resource "olivares_model_access" "allow_gpt4" {
  subject_type  = "group"
  subject_ref   = "engineering"
  model_pattern = "gpt-4*"
  effect        = "allow"
  priority      = 10
}

resource "olivares_model_access" "deny_expensive" {
  subject_type  = "group"
  subject_ref   = "interns"
  model_pattern = "claude-opus-*"
  effect        = "deny"
  priority      = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effect` (String) Access effect: "allow" or "deny".
- `model_pattern` (String) Glob pattern matched against model identifiers (e.g. "gpt-4*", "claude-*", "*").
- `subject_ref` (String) Reference identifier for the subject (e.g. a role name or user ID).
- `subject_type` (String) Type of subject the rule applies to (e.g. "role", "team", "user", "agent").

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority — higher values win when multiple rules match. Defaults to 0.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Server-assigned creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned model access rule ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-assigned last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).
